ALB distributes API requests; Auto Scaling registers and replaces instances.
EC2 allows API traffic from the ALB security group only.
RDS allows database traffic from the EC2 security group only; no public access.
Solid lines = communication paths. Dashed arrows = monitoring / scaling control.
Amplify and RDS are design choices. This infrastructure is not yet provisioned.
